d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Kitchen professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As a Chef de Partie you are responsible to take care of the daily food preparation and duties assigned to meet the set standard and qualities.
q: You should have a professional kitchen apprenticeship or chefs training course and previous experience in quality establishments along with good culinary skills. The ability to communicate well in English and a proven track of food preparation, presentation and preservation knowledge is an essential.
The ideal candidate will be positively spirited, passionate about food and committed to work together with the service team to deliver an amazing guest experiences every time.

You are a positive, dynamic, creative and dedicated team player with the ability to work in a multicultural environment and under difficult condition while possessing the following additional competencies
r: Prepare the daily mis en place and food production in different sections of the main kitchen or satellites

Follow the instructions and recommendations from the immediate superiors to complete the daily tasks
Ensure the highest standards and consistent quality in the daily preparation and keep up-to-date with the new products, recipes and preparation techniques

The Senior Manager Tax – MENAT will provide specialist support for VAT compliance, transformation and risk management across GCC sites. This role will help enhance end-of-the-end VAT processes, improve data quality, standardise execution, strengthen controls, increase automation and ensure accurate and timely compliance.

The role will also support international tax, transfer pricing and internal M&A matters, working collaboratively with stakeholders across Tax, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk and the business.
q: A graduation degree is essential for obtaining a visa and work permit. If your university certificate is from outside the UAE, up-to-date attestations and equivalency are also mandatory (Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications Issued Outside The UAE).
A professional qualification in tax, accounting, finance or law is required. Chartered Accountant, CPA, ACCA, CTA or equivalent qualifications are strongly preferred.
Significant tax experience, including deep practical expertise in VAT across GCC jurisdictions.
Significant experience with the Big Four firms and strong tax experience within financial services, preferably banking.
Experience engaging with tax authorities and managing VAT audits, disputes, appeals or litigation support.
Sound knowledge of corporate tax, transfer pricing, international tax, tax treaties, permanent establishment, withholding tax and tax accounting.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, practical advice to senior stakeholders.
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret financial, transactional and operational data.
Experience using technology and automation to improve tax processes, controls and reporting.
Good project-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and manage competing priorities.
A collaborative and delivery-focused approach, with sound judgement, integrity and the confidence to challenge constructively.
Ability to work effectively across functions and locations in a complex, highly regulated organisation.
Commitment to HSBC’s values, policies, risk-management standards, confidentiality and information-security requirements.
For further details and application information, please visit our careers site and search using reference number 65042.
r: Lead the enhancement and transformation of VAT compliance processes across GCC sites.
Standardise VAT processes, improve source data and reconciliations, strengthen controls and enhance management reporting.
Lead or support VAT regulatory and transformation projects, including e-invoicing implementation.
Assess process, control, data and technology requirements and support testing and business implementation.
Monitor VAT legislation and business developments, assessing their impact on processes, systems and controls.
Provide practical VAT advice on new products, business initiatives, entity changes, systems and operating-model developments.
Manage VAT risk and support tax authority engagements, including audits, assessments, information requests, rulings, voluntary disclosures and disputes.
Support the remediation of VAT compliance and control issues, ensuring clear actions, ownership and timely follow-up.
Support international tax and transfer pricing matters, including cross-border and intercompany arrangements, permanent establishment, treaty and withholding tax considerations.
Provide specialist tax support for internal acquisitions, disposals, restructurings and other M&A transactions.
Manage relationships with external compliance partners and professional advisers, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.
Build effective relationships across Tax, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk and the business, communicating complex tax matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
